BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE project_authoring_flow (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    learning_path_id uuid NOT NULL,
    idempotency_key uuid NOT NULL,
    request_hash varchar(71) NOT NULL,
    status varchar(16) NOT NULL,
    version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    learning_path_version bigint NOT NULL,
    path_snapshot_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL,
    authoring_profile_version bigint NOT NULL,
    authoring_profile_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL,
    goal_code varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    input_json jsonb NOT NULL,
    authoring_request_json jsonb NOT NULL,
    authoring_input_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL,
    confirmation_idempotency_key uuid NULL,
    confirmation_digest varchar(71) NULL,
    confirmed_at timestamptz(6) NULL,
    tz_authoring_job_id uuid NULL,
    tz_job_status varchar(16) NULL,
    ready_blueprint_digest varchar(71) NULL,
    ready_candidate_digest varchar(71) NULL,
    ready_contract_digest varchar(71) NULL,
    ready_capabilities_digest varchar(71) NULL,
    ready_verification_digest varchar(71) NULL,
    ready_at timestamptz(6) NULL,
    publication_idempotency_key uuid NULL,
    publication_request_digest varchar(71) NULL,
    publication_requested_at timestamptz(6) NULL,
    publication_receipt_json jsonb NULL,
    publication_receipt_digest varchar(71) NULL,
    published_at timestamptz(6) NULL,
    failure_code varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    claim_token uuid NULL,
    lease_until timestamptz(6) NULL,
    next_attempt_at timestamptz(6) NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz(6) NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamptz(6) NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT uq_project_authoring_student_key UNIQUE(student_id, idempotency_key),
    CONSTRAINT uq_project_authoring_tz_job UNIQUE(tz_authoring_job_id),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_status CHECK(status IN ('PROPOSED','CONFIRMED','AUTHORING','READY','PUBLISHED','FAILED')),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_version CHECK(version >= 1),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_attempts CHECK(attempts >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_path_version CHECK(learning_path_version >= 1),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_profile_version CHECK(authoring_profile_version >= 1),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_request_hash CHECK(request_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_path_digest CHECK(path_snapshot_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_profile_digest CHECK(authoring_profile_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_input_digest CHECK(authoring_input_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_input_shape CHECK(jsonb_typeof(input_json)='object' AND input_json->>'schema'='planner-project-authoring-input.v1'),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_request_shape CHECK(jsonb_typeof(authoring_request_json)='object' AND authoring_request_json->>'schema'='tz-planning-request.v2' AND authoring_request_json#>>'{orchestration,surface_classification}'='project' AND authoring_request_json#>>'{orchestration,trigger}'='planner_recommendation'),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_confirmation_all_or_none CHECK((confirmation_idempotency_key IS NULL AND confirmation_digest IS NULL AND confirmed_at IS NULL) OR (confirmation_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND confirmation_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND confirmed_at IS NOT NULL)),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_tz_status CHECK(tz_job_status IS NULL OR tz_job_status IN ('PLANNED','GENERATING','VERIFYING','READY','FAILED')),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_tz_identity CHECK((tz_authoring_job_id IS NULL AND tz_job_status IS NULL) OR (tz_authoring_job_id IS NOT NULL AND tz_job_status IS NOT NULL)),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_ready_all_or_none CHECK(
        (ready_blueprint_digest IS NULL AND ready_candidate_digest IS NULL AND ready_contract_digest IS NULL AND ready_capabilities_digest IS NULL AND ready_verification_digest IS NULL AND ready_at IS NULL)
        OR
        (ready_blueprint_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND ready_candidate_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND ready_contract_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND ready_capabilities_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND ready_verification_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND ready_at IS NOT NULL)
    ),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_publish_request_all_or_none CHECK((publication_idempotency_key IS NULL AND publication_request_digest IS NULL AND publication_requested_at IS NULL) OR (publication_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND publication_request_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND publication_requested_at IS NOT NULL)),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_publication_all_or_none CHECK((publication_receipt_json IS NULL AND publication_receipt_digest IS NULL AND published_at IS NULL) OR (jsonb_typeof(publication_receipt_json)='object' AND publication_receipt_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND published_at IS NOT NULL)),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_state_shape CHECK(
        status='FAILED'
        OR (status='PROPOSED' AND confirmation_idempotency_key IS NULL AND tz_authoring_job_id IS NULL AND ready_at IS NULL AND publication_requested_at IS NULL AND published_at IS NULL)
        OR (status='CONFIRMED' AND confirmation_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND tz_authoring_job_id IS NULL AND ready_at IS NULL AND publication_requested_at IS NULL AND published_at IS NULL)
        OR (status='AUTHORING' AND confirmation_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND ready_at IS NULL AND publication_requested_at IS NULL AND published_at IS NULL)
        OR (status='READY' AND confirmation_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND tz_authoring_job_id IS NOT NULL AND ready_at IS NOT NULL AND published_at IS NULL)
        OR (status='PUBLISHED' AND confirmation_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND tz_authoring_job_id IS NOT NULL AND ready_at IS NOT NULL AND publication_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND published_at IS NOT NULL)
    ),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_failure CHECK((status='FAILED')=(failure_code<>'')),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_lease_pair CHECK((claim_token IS NULL)=(lease_until IS NULL)),
    CONSTRAINT ck_project_authoring_time_order CHECK(updated_at >= created_at AND next_attempt_at >= created_at)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_project_authoring_claim
    ON project_authoring_flow(next_attempt_at, created_at, id)
    WHERE status IN ('CONFIRMED','AUTHORING') OR (status='READY' AND publication_requested_at IS NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX idx_project_authoring_student_path
    ON project_authoring_flow(student_id, learning_path_id, created_at DESC);
-- One live flow per immutable Student owner snapshot. FAILED flows are retained
-- for audit but deliberately permit a fresh retry after remediation.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_project_authoring_live_snapshot
    ON project_authoring_flow(
        student_id, learning_path_id, learning_path_version, path_snapshot_digest,
        authoring_profile_version, authoring_profile_digest
    )
    WHERE status <> 'FAILED';

CREATE FUNCTION reject_project_authoring_identity_mutation() RETURNS trigger AS $$
BEGIN
    IF NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id
       OR NEW.student_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.student_id
       OR NEW.learning_path_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.learning_path_id
       OR NEW.idempotency_key IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.idempotency_key
       OR NEW.request_hash IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.request_hash
       OR NEW.learning_path_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.learning_path_version
       OR NEW.path_snapshot_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.path_snapshot_digest
       OR NEW.authoring_profile_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.authoring_profile_version
       OR NEW.authoring_profile_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.authoring_profile_digest
       OR NEW.goal_code IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.goal_code
       OR NEW.input_json IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.input_json
       OR NEW.authoring_request_json IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.authoring_request_json
       OR NEW.authoring_input_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.authoring_input_digest
       OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at
       OR (OLD.confirmation_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.confirmation_idempotency_key IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.confirmation_idempotency_key OR NEW.confirmation_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.confirmation_digest OR NEW.confirmed_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.confirmed_at))
       OR (OLD.tz_authoring_job_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.tz_authoring_job_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.tz_authoring_job_id)
       OR (OLD.ready_at IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.ready_blueprint_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ready_blueprint_digest OR NEW.ready_candidate_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ready_candidate_digest OR NEW.ready_contract_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ready_contract_digest OR NEW.ready_capabilities_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ready_capabilities_digest OR NEW.ready_verification_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ready_verification_digest OR NEW.ready_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ready_at))
       OR (OLD.publication_idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.publication_idempotency_key IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.publication_idempotency_key OR NEW.publication_request_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.publication_request_digest OR NEW.publication_requested_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.publication_requested_at))
       OR (OLD.publication_receipt_json IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.publication_receipt_json IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.publication_receipt_json OR NEW.publication_receipt_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.publication_receipt_digest OR NEW.published_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.published_at))
    THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'project authoring immutable identity cannot be changed';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_project_authoring_identity_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE ON project_authoring_flow
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_project_authoring_identity_mutation();

COMMIT;
